scope.applicability: Shared meaning of a frozen semantic handling bundle for one bounded goal, originating intent, context, named consumer and declared intended use. Captured standing and later-use readiness remain distinct.
exclusions: Canonical definition admission by candidate generation.
Authority to change an external organization or production system.

scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Definition Pack is an identifiable, version-exact semantic bundle for one bounded goal, originating intent, declared context, named consumer and intended use. It records the required concept set and exactly one current handling disposition for each concept: reuse, specialize, propose or open. Each disposition has its matching payload. The Pack freezes selected sources and evidence with their standing at capture, owner routes or explicit ownership gaps, scoped relationship records, unresolved obligations, validation scope and the limits of its claim. Reused meanings retain their exact authority. A specialization explicitly distinguishes an application within an existing meaning from a proposed new or revised normative meaning. Pack existence, well-formedness and readiness for a named use do not themselves admit a Definition or permit execution. The Pack may embed exact Definition applications, task values, task-local proposed meanings and separately attributable assessments as individually addressable records. Task-local proposals remain explicitly unadmitted. Existing meaning applications preserve their selected meaning; new or changed meaning intended for admission requires complete Definition preparation under an explicit materialization selection. Disposition, scope, standing, materialization and assessment outcome remain independent. Assessments are optional; Pack preparation does not manufacture an Evaluation execution or accepted fact.
scientific_formal.formal_expression: P=(id,revision,g,i,k,u,C,delta,H,E,O,R,Q,V,A,M,B,Y); D={reuse,specialize,propose,open}; WellFormed(P) iff ExactIdentity(id,revision) and BoundedGoalContextUse(g,k,u) and TraceableIntent(g,i) and FiniteNonempty(C) and (delta in Functions(C,D)) and (dom(H)=C) and (forall c in C: PayloadMatches(H(c),delta(c))) and (forall r in References(P): (ResolvedWithStandingAtCapture(r) or DeclaredGap(r,Q))) and ValidationScopeDeclared(V) and EmbeddedMeaningBindingsValid(M,B) and SeparateAssessmentBindingsValid(Y,B,E) and MaterializationSelectionExplicit(H) and NoNewAuthorityFromPack(A). WellFormed(P) does not entail ReadyFor(P,u,current_inputs), Admitted(Candidates(P)), or MayExecute(u).

notation.meaning: The frozen bundle; id/revision identify its exact selected material and declared lineage.
Bounded goal, attributable intent, explicit context, named consumer with one declared intended use.
Finite nonempty set of distinct required concept identities. Duplicate rows must be rejected before constructing it.
Exactly reuse, specialize, propose and open.
One total single-valued current handling choice for every required concept.
Matching payload function with domain C; specialization declares application-parameters or proposed-semantic-change.
Captured source/evidence standing, owner routes or ownership gaps, scoped relationships and unresolved obligations.
Declared validation profile, subject/input bindings, criteria/outcome scope and evidence ceiling.
No new semantic admission or action permission is created by the Pack; separately admitted source meanings keep their authority.
Exact resolved reference and declared posture in the frozen source epoch. This does not assert currentness for every later use.
Use-specific gate evaluated separately against current inputs and applicable obligations. Reviewable does not mean executable.
Proposed Definition outputs, possibly none; their exact owner decisions remain separate.

Embedded task-local meaning proposals, Definition application records and separate assessments. Any collection may be empty; nonempty assessment entries bind exact application/input evidence and preserve execution/claim posture.

Task-local proposed meaning is embedded by default. Creating a separately reviewable complete Definition candidate requires an explicit intent/purpose, scope and owner route. Neither placement nor selection admits it.

boundary_conditions: The required concept set is declared and bounded; complete handling does not prove exhaustive discovery of every relevant concept.
An unresolved outcome has an explicit question, reason, affected use, owner route or ownership gap and continuation; it is never an invented answer.
Reuse binds one exact current admitted meaning at capture and its applicability; a later change in source standing requires separate current-use assessment.

Specialization within the parent meaning produces a Definition application under its declared parameter contract. A new or changed meaning is an explicitly unadmitted task-local proposal by default; selecting it for admission requires complete Definition preparation through the explicit identity/successor route.
One Pack can yield zero, one or many Definition candidates; it does not own their normative meanings.
Role/owner routing labels and producer attribution do not establish Role Assignments or action permission.
A source resolving is distinct from its admission, currentness, truth and permitted use.
Relationship suggestions are scoped records; they do not create global Typed Relations.

A changed selected input, intended use, payload, concept set or meaning produces a new frozen revision with lineage; current-use assessments may be separate records and do not rewrite the frozen Pack.
Validation scope is required even when all selected references resolve.
Independent review, consumer-use, semantic-owner, capability-adoption and execution decisions retain their own scopes.
No semantic admission or new action permission is inferred from this bundle or any structural PASS.
A Definition application binds values under the selected meaning; it cannot override, weaken or extend that meaning.
Meaning identity/version, binding values, captured standing, intended authority scope, materialization and assessment outcome are independent selections.
Task-local proposals remain explicitly unadmitted. An application of one supports bounded proposal examination, not substitution for an applicable admitted meaning or Policy.
Applications and task assessments are embedded, separately addressable entries in a Pack. They are not new independently admitted Artifact Types in this release.
A changed binding or input/evidence epoch creates a new application or assessment revision with lineage; historical Pack bytes remain preserved.
An application is not an Evaluation execution, Measurement Result, Finding, owner Decision, Model Instance Binding or proof of an applied effect.
No recorded assessment is inferred from a binding. Counts or an outcome without exact evidence and producer/execution posture are not a completed governed Evaluation.
Promotion/materialization requires an explicit purpose, authority scope and applicable owner route; repeated use alone selects no admission.
testable_conditions: Missing, duplicate or undeclared concept dispositions fail well-formedness.
Every disposition payload matches its exact tag; specialization declares whether normative meaning changes.
A resolved candidate source cannot be labeled admitted reuse merely because its reference resolves.
An unresolved source or owner has a visible scoped gap.
All references resolving with validation scope absent still fails well-formedness.
A frozen valid record can remain reviewable when its source standing has changed; a new consequential use still requires current-source/owner assessment.
Partial selection cannot resolve or authorize unselected concepts.
A Pack with a proposed meaning does not imply an admitted Definition or an authorized agent action.
The incident binds S, A, F and E without changing the inclusion predicate.
Changing E creates another binding revision and invalidates the old assessment for that changed binding.
Adding an undeclared tolerance parameter is rejected; changing the required coverage threshold requires a meaning proposal.
A binding can exist without any assessment; one application may have several separately versioned assessments.
A task-local candidate criterion can yield an illustrative PASS while shared admission and incident closure remain unselected.
Exact local selectors and subtree digests resolve applications and their evidence inside one Pack without self-hashing the Pack.

plain_language.explanation: For one task, the Pack records which concepts the work needs, what can be reused, what is being narrowed or proposed, and what remains unanswered. It keeps the exact sources, context, ownership questions and limits visible so the next person or agent can review the meaning without guessing. A saved Pack preserves what was known then; using it later requires checking what has changed. Task values and results stay inside the Pack. A new working meaning can stay there as an unadmitted proposal; a separate Definition is prepared when its purpose and intended authority scope are explicitly selected.

domain_context.explanation: The incident Pack embeds one task-local proposed completeness meaning, its S/A/F/E application, saved synthetic input evidence and a separate coverage assessment. Incident is reused, Work is applied without semantic change, completeness remains proposed and account exclusivity remains open. No per-incident Definition or assessment file is emitted.
examples: INC-1042 keeps its account, filters, snapshot and saved output in the application record.
The embedded assessment reports 200 missing required IDs under the proposed criterion; the criterion itself remains unadmitted.
A later retry has a new application/assessment epoch under the same meaning.
Account exclusivity remains open even when identifier coverage passes.

No independent owner fidelity acceptance, global semantic proof, production Evaluation, profile/type adoption, admission or application.
